transcript: Khatoon, 26 saal. 2 din se peshab mein jalan hai. HB 12 baar. Atax hai. Bukhar nahi. Kamar mein dard hai. Pregnant nahi hai. Cipro 500 din mein do baar, 3 din. Paani zyada piye shaam ko. Tast karwa lein. 3 din mein farq na pare to do baar. Aayein.

medications.name: Ciprofloxacin
medications.instructions: Drink plenty of water in the evening. If no improvement in 3 days, repeat twice.

advice: Drink plenty of water in the evening.
note.follow_up: If no improvement in 3 days, return.
